text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High.
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you.
Do all in the name of the Lord Jesus.
Yahweh looks at the heart.
I am the light of the world.
Rejoice in the Lord always!
Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love.
My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
If God is for us, who can be against us?
The light shines in the darkness.
Now faith is assurance of things hoped for.
Seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness.
Let’s not be weary in doing good.
He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
All things work together for good for those who love God.
To love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.
Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid.
Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good.
Let all that you do be done in love.
Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go.
I will give you rest.
Christ has made us free.
We walk by faith, not by sight.
Yahweh bless you, and keep you.
In nothing be anxious.
God is faithful.
In everything give thanks.
The peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts.
Hope doesn’t disappoint us.
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart.
You are my hiding place.
I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
He gives power to the weak.
Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
For Yahweh is good.
Don’t be afraid. I will help you.
In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
Hope in God!
Also delight yourself in Yahweh.
The glory which will be revealed toward us.
Be still, and know that I am God.
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace.
God didn’t give us a spirit of fear.
There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus.
Aren’t you of much more value than they?
God meant it for good.
Be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other.
Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.
I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you.
Let him not leave us or forsake us.
Seek, and you will find.
But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives.
I know that you can do all things.
I am the resurrection and the life.
My God will supply every need of yours.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory.
Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God.
When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
Think about these things.
I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
A cheerful heart makes good medicine.
Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you.
Seek Yahweh and his strength.
Your joy may be made full.
Commit your way to Yahweh.
I sought Yahweh, and he answered me.
Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit.
Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.
They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
Be strong and courageous, and do it.
Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
He who promised is faithful.
This is the day that Yahweh has made.
Yah is my strength and song.
In all your ways acknowledge him.
He who began a good work in you will complete it.
You will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you.
Our inward person is renewed day by day.
My loving kindness will not depart from you.
Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.
He is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins.
God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
I am the vine. You are the branches.
But you be strong, and don’t let your hands be slack.
He will not fail you nor forsake you.
Let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally.
By grace you have been saved through faith.
Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.
Yahweh is my strength and my shield.
Perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
Build each other up.
Able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think.
God is love.
We are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works.
To give you hope and a future.
Always rejoice.
I will not fail you nor forsake you.
God is our refuge and strength.
Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you.
My grace is sufficient for you.
Rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer.
The greatest of these is love.
My soul, wait in silence for God alone.
Let your light shine before men.
Let the peace of God rule in your hearts.
Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart.
May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace.
Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.
With God all things are possible.
My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.
His mercies don’t fail.
Yahweh himself is who goes before you.
For nothing spoken by God is impossible.
Greater is he who is in you.
All things are possible to him who believes.
We are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
Yahweh will give grace and glory.
Behold, it was very good.
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
I will also give you a new heart.
Keep your heart with all diligence.
I will rejoice in Yahweh.
Yahweh’s name is a strong tower.
I will in no way leave you.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage.
Behold, I am with you always.
It is more blessed to give than to receive.
Pray without ceasing.
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace.
He will calm you in his love.
He is a new creation.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
They will mount up with wings like eagles.
Don’t let your heart be troubled.
Be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness.
All things are possible with God.
Yahweh will guide you continually.
Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above.
Don’t be afraid, little flock.
I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh.
Yahweh is my light and my salvation.
The Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you.
Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling.
Cheer up! I have overcome the world.
Whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
